{{Otheruses|Overlord}}
{{Quote|We can become the overlords of the galaxy!|[[Durga Besadii Tai]]|<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
'''Overlord''' was the title held by leaders or high-ranking individuals within various organizations.<ref name="ENDTSD">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref><ref name="Xim Week">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek04/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part III: Xim at Vondor)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref><ref name="XW">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref>

In the [[Pre-Republic era]], [[Kral (title)|Overlord (Kral)]] was the title of the political leader of the planet [[Shikaakwa]].<ref name="DotJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> [[Sith'ari/Legends|Overlord (Sith'ari)]] was a title chosen by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="ENDTSD" /> [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] also held the title of overlord.<ref name="Xim Week" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[Overlord (Imperial)|Overlord]] was a rank of [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="XW" /> The title was also held by several officers of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> The leader of the [[Rak'qua]] tribe was also known as an overlord.<ref name="SWG:SG2">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Station Gamma}}</ref> [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Malameu Toda]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] used the title of "overlord of the outer territories."<ref name="AGttSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Moruth Doole]] wore the title of overlord as he ruled the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="TJAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

When not used as a formal title, the term overlord was sometimes used to designate powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]].<ref name="HG">''[[Hero's Grave]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref><ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Moreover, the designation of overlord was frequently used to qualify the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as they control entire worlds and dominate their inhabitants while being crime lords and [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] at the same time.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref><ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref><ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
